ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points C, M, and N are on line segment AB, with $AC=12$, $BC=6$, $AM=\frac{1}{3}AC$, and $BN=\frac{1}{3}BC$. What is the length of line segment MN?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
Since $AC=12$,\\
it follows that $AM=\frac{1}{3}AC=4$,\\
Since $BC=6$,\\
it follows that $BN=\frac{1}{3}BC=2$,\\
Therefore, $MN=AB-AM-BN=AC+BC-AM-BN=12+6-4-2=\boxed{12}$.
